summary.intent: The user wanted to investigate why the IPNS entries by type panel showed 0 file records despite 769 file uploads during a 50-user load test, and then remove the stale release-as pins CI check that was blocking releases.
summary.outcome: A pre-existing SDK bug was identified (file IPNS records mislabeled as 'folder' due to missing recordType in createFileMetadata) but not yet fixed. The stale release-as pins CI action, its script, and its test were fully removed and committed on the chore branch.

repo: The folder_ipns table stores both folder and file IPNS records distinguished only by record_type; 0 file rows with 769 uploads is a labeling bug, not missing data.
addFileToFolder/addFilesToFolder in registration.ts correctly set recordType:'file' but are dead code — client.ts reimplements the upload flow inline and omits the tag.
record_type is used only by the metrics gauge and two log strings; no functional code branches on it, so the mislabeling is cosmetic.
The stale release-as pins check lived in .github/workflows/ci.yml as two steps plus packages/scripts/check-stale-release-as.js and a companion test file.
CLAUDE.md line 196 had a live reference to the now-deleted check-stale-release-as.js script that required updating.

code.finding: createFileMetadata returns an ipnsRecord with no recordType field, causing server to default it to 'folder'.
batchPublishIpnsRecords([uploadResult.ipnsRecord], …) publishes the untagged record as-is; also at line 1332.
Server defaults absent recordType to 'folder': entry.recordType ?? 'folder', which silently swallows the missing tag.
Correct path (addFileToFolder/addFilesToFolder) sets recordType:'file' at lines 329, 405, 438 but is not called by the web upload path.

workflow: Sub-agent findings should be spot-verified at the specific lines cited before presenting as conclusions — the assistant confirmed client.ts:1067 and ipns.service.ts:181 manually after the sub-agent reported them.
When removing a CI step, also check CLAUDE.md and docs for dangling references to deleted scripts.
Prettier is used as the pre-commit YAML linter, so prettier --check is the right pre-commit validation step for .github/workflows files.

friction: The stale release-as pins CI check was blocking/annoying the user every time they created a release — no longer added value.
CLAUDE.md retained a stale reference to the deleted script, requiring a follow-up edit after the deletion.
Historical phase records in .planning/phases/53-* also reference the deleted concept but were intentionally left (read-only history).
The Grafana panel stuck at 43 because the zero-state fix (PR #561) hadn't merged yet, and the current staging deploy predated it.
open_items: Fix createFileMetadata in packages/sdk-core/src/file/index.ts to add recordType:'file' to the returned ipnsRecord — fix deferred, not yet shipped.
769 existing mislabeled file records in staging DB carry record_type='folder'; no backfill planned (cosmetic + staging wiped regularly).
PR #561 (zero-state gauge fix) still needs to merge and staging needs to redeploy before the stale 43 clears from the Grafana dashboard.
The by-type panel will only show correct file counts after both the recordType fix ships and staging is redeployed.
